costs._note: Public cost evidence for new AL/MC in the region. CN 'total project cost' is the applicant's filed budget; loan amounts are construction loans, so total cost is higher.
psf: Weitz / ASHA, AL hard cost, mid-level
Weitz / ASHA, AL hard cost, high-level
costs.verdict: Two independent comps (Benchmark East Brunswick and the Cortlandt site plan itself) show about 969 SF a unit for AL/MC, against the 828 we used. Building size was raised (AL 950, MC 800 SF a unit), lifting all-in cost on a 114-unit pad from about $505K to $540K a unit. That now sits between the Benchmark loan-implied figure and the Peapack CN budget. Our $342-360/SF hard cost is at the low end of Weitz's national high-level AL range before any New York premium, so a GC estimate is the remaining test (Ben to commission).
